designs.title: Playa Venao
designs.why: Clean one-ink art: no stroke under ~0.4 mm, no specks, solid ring and type. Only risk is the dense water hatching and fern clusters, where paper gaps drop to ~0.4 mm and can close up on the black tee with a white underbase.
designs.fix: Open the tightest gaps in the wave lines and foliage to at least 0.5 mm (6 px), or choke the white-ink film a touch, so the black version holds.

designs.title: San Juan del Sur
designs.why: Same clean film as the others: lines all at least ~0.4 mm, zero specks. The town rooftops under the Cristo and the boats are the busiest small detail and the likeliest to fill in with white ink.
designs.fix: Simplify the rooftop/window hatching on the hill so the gaps there are at least 0.5 mm before burning the white-ink screen.

designs.title: Haleiwa
designs.why: Easiest of the three to print: fewest tight gaps, open sky, crisp sign lettering, a solid ring. The wave barrel's fine curl lines are the only spot to watch on white ink.
designs.fix: Thicken the spray and curl lines in the barrel slightly so they don't break up on a 156-mesh white print.
